note: Rejection cases for the physics-pendulum worked example. Every label was written BEFORE the case was run. A case must be REFUSED with the named gate(s); the pack's own records.jsonl is the ACCEPTED control set. Deliberately wrong scientific claims: each one is a plausible-sounding error this pack must catch.
